notes: §1985:VI.6.22.4 GR10 figure 1: an index setting '>' the highest permissible occurrence goes to AT END (or the end of the SEARCH), '<=' evaluates condition-1, condition-2 in order, and when none holds the search index (index-name-1 if VARYING names one of this table) and the VARYING other-table index or identifier-2 are incremented and the test repeats. SearchBinder.BindSearch picks the search index and the in-step augment and sets IndexBelowTableIsUnsuccessful false at 85 (DialectBehavior.SearchIndexBelowTableUnsuccessful starts at 2002, PB5121), so ControlFlowEmitter.EmitSerialScan emits the start test '> bound' alone, EmitSearchWhens the ordered WHEN arms, then the increment and the bound re-test. Probes at --std 85 (work-rd-04/c1/p1.cob): (a) ODO table bound tracks the DEPENDING value (CNT=3 AT END for occurrence 4; CNT=5 finds it at +4); start above bound without AT END falls to the next statement; VARYING another table's index JX moves 5->7 with IX 2->4; VARYING a second index IY of the same table is the search index, IX untouched; VARYING signed integer K -3 -> -1 and an index data item move in step; AT END leaves IX one past (6); index 0 from PERFORM VARYING BY -1 evaluates the WHEN (REACHED 1) at 85 but AT END at 2002/2023 (edition arm proven); NEXT SENTENCE and GO TO out of an arm work. Witness exercises AT END, VARYING K, first-true-wins and index-at-0. Lead for the GR2b row, not this figure (which loops back to the '>' test only): an index started at -1 (PERFORM ... BY -2) is evaluated at -1, 0 and 1 (B0 REACHED 1), where §1985:VI.6.22.4 GR2b says a new index value 'outside the permissible range' ends the search 'as indicated in 2a above'.

next.reason: The 1985 figure (illustrative, like its 2023 copy in informative Annex §2023:D.3.5.4, which has no catalog rule) routes a starting index 'greater than' the highest occurrence to AT END and any index '≤' it to condition-1. 2023's normative flow is §2023:14.9.37.4 GR1 (success/AT END transfers), GR3 (which index and VARYING item are incremented) and GR4, which differs: an index that 'corresponds to an occurrence number that is negative, zero, or greater than the highest permissible occurrence number for identifier-1, the search operation is unsuccessful', setting EC-RANGE-SEARCH-INDEX (the Annex figure now reads 'exceeds highest permissible occurrence, or is zero or negative'). 1985 lets an index stand at 0 after PERFORM VARYING ... BY -1 ('outside the range of the associated table by one increment or decrement value'); a following SEARCH whose WHEN does not reference the table evaluates its conditions in 1985 but takes AT END in 2023.
